استقرضنا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْرَضْنَا (istaqraḍnā) /is.taq.radˤ.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
# اُسْتُقْرِضْنَا (ustuqriḍnā) /us.tuq.ridˤ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
